verdict.rationale: The evidence shows built-in metrics that can be enabled in config, plus a community-described debugger (Whisker) for live pipeline inspection while debugging. Neither is a documented production call-monitoring capability. Nothing in the pack shows alerting on agent misbehavior or error-rate spikes, so these items are building blocks or adjacent debugging tools rather than the story's capability.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can monitor live calls in production and get alerts when agents misbehave or error rates spike
